VAR-centralacc.why: Heating system categories include Radiator (Joint or central heating), which can indicate access to central heating.

VAR-heatsource.why: Heating system available (stove/radiator/air conditioner/none) could serve as closest available proxy for main heating source/type.

VAR-toiletacc.why: Indoor flushing toilet in dwelling provides direct evidence for access to a flush toilet.

VAR-opendef.why: Presence/absence of an indoor flushing toilet is the only sanitation-access indicator in the housing module; may help classify any toilet facility vs none.

VAR-piped.why: Piped water system in the dwelling provides direct evidence for piped water access.

VAR-pipedtoprem.why: Piped water system in the dwelling implies piped water on premises (at least in dwelling).

notes: Survey index shows only housing-conditions access/possession variables (piped water, flush toilet, heating system), not detailed water/sanitation type questions or any utility/fuel/telecom expenditures.
